rows.Benefits Description.Hospice/ End of lif: Remission is the halt or actual reduction in the progression of illness resulting in discharge from a hospice care program with no further expenses incurred. A readmission within three months of a prior discharge is considered as the same period of care. A new period begins after three months from a prior discharge with maximum benefits available. Note: See Section 5(a), Diagnostic treatment and services, for information on advance care planning coverage.
rows.You pay the calendar year deductible….Af: In-network: Nothing up to the Plan limits Out-of-network: Nothing up to the Plan limits
rows.You pay the calendar year deductible….St: In-network: Nothing up to the Plan limits Out-of-network: Nothing up to the Plan limits

rows.Benefits Description.Hospice/ End of lif: Not covered: • Charges incurred during a period of remission, charges incurred for treatment of a sickness or injury of a family member that are covered under another plan provision, charges incurred for services rendered by a close relative • Bereavement counseling, pastoral counseling, financial or legal counseling • Funeral arrangements

Local ambulance service, within 100 miles*, only when medically necessary and the patient cannot be transported by other means to: • the first hospital where treated • from the first hospital to the next nearest hospital or other medical facility only if necessary, treatment is unavailable or medically unsuitable at the first hospital • the home, only when the patient requires the assistance of medically trained personnel during transportation *Member is responsible for all charges for 100 miles or greater when medically necessary treatment is available within 100 miles.
rows.You pay the calendar year deductible….Af: In-network: 10% of the Plan allowance Out-of-network: 10% of the Plan allowance and any difference between our allowance and the billed amount
rows.You pay the calendar year deductible….St: In-network: 15% of the Plan allowance Out-of-network: 15% of the Plan allowance and any difference between our allowance and the billed amount

rows.Benefits Description.Hospice/ End of lif: Air ambulance to nearest hospital is only covered when medically necessary, and the severity of the member's condition warrants immediate evacuation, and: • the pick-up location is inaccessible by other means, or • transportation by any other means could further endanger the member's health, and • the patient is transported to the nearest facility where medically necessary treatment is available.
rows.You pay the calendar year deductible….Af: In-network: 10% of the Plan allowance Out-of-network: 10% of the Plan allowance
rows.You pay the calendar year deductible….St: In-network: 15% of the Plan allowance Out-of-network: 15% of the Plan allowance

rows.Benefits Description.Hospice/ End of lif: Note: Medical Necessity review is required for all air ambulance transportation. Not covered: • Ambulance transportation when the patient does not require the assistance of medically trained personnel and can be safely transferred (or transported) by other means
